senses.gloss: to take breath, to rest. Pesik. B’shall., p. 93ᵃ בעי את למִנַּשְּׁמָא וכ׳ wouldst thou rest a while?
to recover, get well. Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ bot.; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ לחש … וא׳ he whispered …, and the person recovered, v. יֵשׁוּ.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 11</cite> <he>כחול … ואת מִנַּשְּׁמָה</he> use my eye-paint, and thou shalt get well. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ bot. <he>אִינַּשְּׁמַת</he> it (the tooth) was cured; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <cite ref="N01331"><he>אִתְנְשִׁימַת</he></cite> (some ed. <he>אִתְנַשְּׁמִית</he> I feel better).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>רוקי … ואנא מִינְּשִׁים</he> spit in my face seven times, and I shall be cured.

senses.gloss: to breathe, to give signs of life.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 134a">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>האי</he> … <he>דלא מִינַּשְׁתֵּם</he> Rashi a. Ms. O. (ed. <he>מנשתי</he>, <he>מנשתיה</he>; Rashi Ms. <he>מִנְּשִׁים</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40; Ms. M. <he>מנשתין</he>) an infant which gives no signs of life.
